# Golden regions of the 6 GiB exFAT media volume (p1) of
# ws2022-win-server-01-install.img -- an image that booted on real Oxide hardware,
# installed Windows Server 2022 unattended, and came up with networking and RDP.
#
# Produced by src/lib/exfat.js. p1 is at LBA 2048 for 12582912 sectors.
#
# boot-sector is fixed entirely by the geometry, and root-metadata by the three
# entries every exFAT root carries -- volume label, allocation bitmap, up-case table.
# Neither depends on what files the volume holds, so both can be checked without the
# ISO or the payload downloads.
#
# The timestamps elsewhere on this volume read 2019-12-31 19:00:00: it was built
# before the local-time-getter fix. See exfat.rs::Timestamp.
#
# fat-head is only the first five FAT entries -- the ones fixed by geometry:
# the media descriptor, the reserved entry, and one cluster each for the
# allocation bitmap, the up-case table and the root directory. Entries past
# those describe files, so they are compared against exfat.js instead.
#
# <name> <hex>
boot-sector 
ext-boot-sector 
checksum-sector 1d054fc61d054fc61d054fc61d054fc6
root-metadata 8308570049004e00530045005400550050000000000000000000000000000000810000000000000000000000000000000000000002000000ff17000000000000820000008f134287000000000000000000000000030000000000020000000000
fat-head f8ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
